boundaries: Source-based model execution, not LDPlayer or an actual player session.
Web RNG/clock/default cohort assumptions remain explicit.
Time advances use natural recovery; the first source-default free refill is allowed only through the ordinary UI action. Paid energy purchases are excluded.
Unopened/unknown reward containers are never assigned guessed contents.
Non-wait actions execute instantaneously. Recorded time sums explicit waits and modeled tutorial delay; it is not measured user interaction duration.
Solver is a bounded heuristic. Failure is a model/solver investigation result, not proof the original game is blocked.
